items.title: Fair Isaac stock plunges 20% after Fannie and Freddie open door to FICO credit score rival
items.summary: Stock in Fair Isaac Corp. fell sharply on Tuesday after the Federal Housing Finance Agency announced a change in mortgage pricing, introducing competition to FICO Score's long hold on mortgage lending.

items.title: Why Equifax (EFX) Shares Are Sliding Today
items.summary: Shares of credit reporting giant Equifax (NYSE:EFX) fell 4.1% in the pre-market session after Federal Housing Finance Agency Director Bill Pulte announced a unified mortgage pricing grid, escalating a regulatory campaign against credit bureau fees that was amplified by a competitor’s price war.

items.title: Fair Isaac Tanks After Government Snaps FICO Score Monopoly For Mortgage Pricing
items.summary: Fair Isaac stock fell around 30% on Tuesday. The drop came after the government announced it would start to use a competitor to the FICO score to determine mortgage prices.

items.title: FICO stock drops 20%: Analysts break down the impact of FHFA’s single pricing grid
items.summary: Investing.com -- Fair Isaac (NYSE: FICO) dropped 20% in premarket trading on Tuesday after Federal Housing Finance Agency Director Bill Pulte announced that Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will adopt a single loan-level pricing adjustment grid covering both FICO and VantageScore, eliminating the pricing differential that had long protected FICO’s dominance in mortgage originations. items.title: The US Moves to End FICO’s Mortgage Scoring Monopoly. The Stock Is Tumbling
items.summary: The U.S. government is moving to bring competition to credit scoring for mortgages. That’s not good news for Fair Isaac shareholders.
